idea-plugin.name: Terminal Tab Switch Shortcuts
idea-plugin.description:
Brings back Select Next / Previous Tab (Alt+Right / Alt+Left by default) inside the reworked terminal on Windows and Linux.

Since 2026.3 the new terminal sends those keys to the shell, so you can no longer switch terminal tabs from the keyboard. This plugin lets just those two IDE actions through. Every other key still goes to the shell. Custom shortcuts for the same actions work too.

Source on GitHub · How it works
idea-plugin.change-notes: First Marketplace release: lets NextTab / PreviousTab through the reworked terminal (2026.3+).
